- [PREFERENCE] User is interested in the Scandinavian minimalism style.

  1. Keep it light and bright.
  2. Use a neutral color palette.
  3. Choose furniture with clean lines and minimal ornamentation.
  4. Incorporate natural materials.
  5. Declutter and edit decor.
  6. Add plants.
  7. Use textiles to add texture.
  8. Bring in industrial accents.
  9. Create a focal point.
  10. Keep wall art simple.
